postings.title: Finance Manager
postings.text:
The Squarespace Finance team is seeking a Finance Manager to serve as a dedicated FP&A business partner to our R&D organization. This is a high-impact, high-autonomy role responsible for overseeing the financial health of a large, complex technology portfolio spanning Engineering, Product, and Squarespace's expanding AI initiatives.

As Squarespace scales its investment in artificial intelligence, this role will be instrumental in building the financial infrastructure to track AI costs, evaluate ROI, and translate complex technology spend into strategic insights for senior leadership. The ideal candidate brings deep financial expertise, strong cross-functional instincts, and the judgment to operate independently in a fast-moving environment.

You will report to the FP&A Director and be based in our New York City office.

You’ll Get To…

• Serve as the primary finance business partner for the R&D organization, including Engineering and Product, owning the full planning cycle: monthly close, forecasting, and annual planning

• Build and own financial frameworks to track AI-related costs end-to-end including model API usage and inference costs, GPU/cloud compute infrastructure, AI tooling and software licenses, and AI-related headcount and contracted services

• Develop ROI methodologies and scorecards for AI initiatives, helping leadership evaluate where investments are generating value and where to reallocate

• Monitor AI spend efficiency metrics such as cost-per-output and cost as a percentage of revenue, and surface trends and anomalies proactively

• Partner with Engineering, Product, and Data Science teams to create visibility into how AI costs scale with product usage, helping the company plan for growth scenarios

• Partner with the FinOps team to track and optimize cloud infrastructure costs, including compute, storage, and data transfer spend across cloud providers and data center environments; collaborate on cloud cost allocation, commitment-based savings strategies , and ongoing efficiency initiatives to ensure infrastructure investment scales responsibly with the business

• Track and forecast all R&D investments including headcount, software, contracted services, and other operating expenses across products globally

• Perform variance analysis and deliver actionable recommendations on spend across organizational teams

• Present financial results and strategic insights independently to executive stakeholders and corporate finance leadership

• Identify and drive process improvements that enhance reporting efficiency and the quality of business metrics

Who We're Looking For

• 8+ years of experience in FP&A or related finance roles, with experience supporting technical or R&D organizations strongly preferred

• Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Accounting

• Deep expertise in financial modeling and FP&A systems (e.g., Workday,, NetSuite); mastery of Excel required

• Demonstrated ability to operate with a high degree of autonomy — making sound decisions on budget, forecasting, and investment analysis without constant oversight

• Strong strategic thinking skills with the ability to develop long-term financial plans and assess risk across a large, multifaceted portfolio

• Intellectually curious about emerging technology, with a willingness to develop fluency in AI cost structures and how they differ from traditional software spend

• Proven ability to communicate complex financial topics clearly to non-financial stakeholders at the executive level

• A self-starter who thrives in dynamic environments and takes ownership of workstreams end-to-end

• Strong ethical foundation with a commitment to presenting unbiased, accurate information to all stakeholders

Benefits & Perks

• A choice between medical plans with an option for 100% covered premiums

• Fertility and adoption benefits

• Access to supplemental insurance plans for additional coverage

• Headspace mindfulness app subscription

• Global Employee Assistance Program

• Retirement benefits with employer match

• Flexible paid time off

• 12 weeks paid parental leave and family care leave

• Pretax commuter benefit

• Education reimbursement

• Employee donation match to community organizations

• 7 Global Employee Resource Groups (ERGs)

• Dog-friendly workplace

• Free lunch and snacks

• Private rooftop

• Hack week twice per year

Cash Compensation Range: $148,500 - $208,000 USD

The base salary for this position will vary based on job-related criteria including relevant skills, experience, and location, among other factors.

In addition to the cash compensation above (which includes base salary and, where applicable for eligible roles, may include overtime pay), Squarespace employees are eligible to be granted an option to purchase our common stock. Sales positions generally offer a competitive On Target Earnings (OTE) incentive structure in addition to base salary.

About Squarespace

Squarespace is a design-driven platform helping entrepreneurs build brands and businesses online. We empower millions of customers in more than 200 countries and territories with all the tools they need to create an online presence, build an audience, monetize, and scale their business. Our suite of products range from websites, domains, ecommerce, and marketing tools, as well as tools for scheduling with Acuity and creating and managing social media presence with Bio Sites and Unfold. Our team of more than 1,700 is headquartered in New York City, with offices in Dublin, Ireland, and Aveiro, Portugal. For more information about our company, visit https://www.squarespace.com/about/careers.

Our Commitment

Today, more than a million people around the globe use Squarespace to share different perspectives and experiences with the world. Not only do we embrace and celebrate the diversity of our customers, but we also work toward the same in our employees. At Squarespace, we are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, religion, national origin, gender, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital or parental status, disability, veteran status, or other class protected by applicable law. We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace.

Squarespace will never solicit your personal banking information or ask you to transfer money in connection with a job offer or interview. We also will not reach out to you via phone or SMS without your permission or knowledge.

postings.title: Senior Director, FP&A
postings.text:
As Senior Director of FP&A, you will lead a high-performing finance team and serve as a strategic partner to the President and executive leadership team, shaping the company’s financial strategy, operating decisions, and long-term growth trajectory. You will own the P&L across all product lines, driving accountability, visibility, and informed decision-making across the portfolio. At the forefront of finance transformation, you will champion the evolution of FP&A through AI-enabled tools, automation, and scalable processes that modernize how we plan, analyze, and deliver insights.

You will report to the Vice President of Finance & Revenue Operations and be based in our New York City headquarters.

You’ll Get To…

Team Leadership & Finance Capability Building

• Build, lead, and develop a high-performing FP&A team, creating a culture of strategic thinking, operational excellence, accountability, and continuous improvement

• Establish scalable FP&A practices, processes, and standards that enable the team to deliver accurate insights and meaningful business partnership

• Hire, develop and retain top talent while strengthening the capabilities required to support a growing, evolving business

Senior Advisor to the President & Executive Leadership Team

• Serve as a key strategic advisor to the President, providing financial insights, recommendations, and perspectives that shape business priorities and decisions

• Partner with the executive leadership team to evaluate the financial implications of business strategies, resource allocation decisions, investments, and key growth initiatives

• Provide actionable recommendations for executive and board level audiences aimed at helping the company achieve financial and operational objectives. Translate complex financial and business data into clear narratives and actionable recommendations for executive and board-level audiences

• Lead preparation of executive and board-level financial presentations, including monthly performance reviews and long-range planning updates

• Support M&A activity and corporate development opportunities, providing financial analysis and due diligence to inform strategic decision-making.

Product P&L Ownership & Business Performance

• Own end-to-end P&L accountability across all product lines, driving financial performance, visibility and commercial decision-making at the portfolio level

• Lead the annual budgeting process and monthly rolling forecast cycle, proactively identifying risks and opportunities across each business unit

• Conduct variance analysis, scenario modeling, and profitability analysis to inform pricing, investment, and resource allocation decisions

• Establish and lead the accountability framework across the organization by partnering with product and business leaders to drive profitability, optimize investments, and support data driven decisionmaking

Finance Transformation & AI

• Lead the evolution of FP&A through automation, analytics, and AI-enabled tools that improve efficiency, accuracy, and speed of insight generation

• Identify opportunities to simplify and scale financial processes while reducing manual reporting and increasing time spent on strategic analysis

• Drive consistent, scalable planning and reporting practices across the organization to enable better business decisions

Who We’re Looking For

• 15+ years of progressive experience in financial planning and analysis, corporate finance,or related strategic finance roles, with experience supporting complex, multi-product businesses. 8+ years of experience leading and developing high-performing finance teams

• Proficient at understanding and proactively communicating the financial implications of business decisions and dynamics

• Experience preparing and presenting financial analysis, forecasting, and recommendations to executives and senior-level stakeholders that drive business results

• Demonstrated experience applying intellectual curiosity to uncover insights and drive differentiated outcomes

• Experience developing and driving financial budgeting and forecasting

• Exceptional analytical and modeling skills with the ability to synthesize and analyze data to create useful information and concise analysis

• Demonstrated experience building scalable finance processes and driving operational improvements through technology, automation, and data-driven solutions

• Keen eye for detail while able to present macro trends to the highest levels of management

• Exceptional communication, executive presence, and storytelling skills with the ability to influence stakeholders across all levels of the organization

Benefits & Perks

• A choice between medical plans with an option for 100% covered premiums including medical, dental, and vision

• Supplemental Life and Disability Insurance plans

• Fertility and adoption benefits

• Headspace mindfulness app subscription

• Global Employee Assistance Program

• Retirement benefits with employer match

• Flexible paid time off

• 12 weeks paid parental leave and family care leave

• Pretax commuter benefit

• Education reimbursement

• Employee donation match to community organizations

• 7 Global Employee Resource Groups (ERGs)

• Dog-friendly workplace

• Free lunch and snacks

• Private rooftop

• Hack week twice per year

Cash Compensation Range: $272,000 - 320,000

The base salary for this position will vary based on job-related criteria including relevant skills, experience, and location, among other factors.
